ui.browser.media_access.prompt_label.role: accessible region name — browser camera/microphone permission band (prompt state)
ui.browser.media_access.prompt_label.note: Names the band while a site is asking. devices select: audio = microphone only, video = camera only, other = both. Keep every arm.

ui.browser.media_access.prompt_dismiss.role: accessible label for an icon-only close button (prompt state)
ui.browser.media_access.prompt_dismiss.note: Closes the band, denying this one request without remembering. devices select as in prompt_label.

ui.browser.media_access.blocked_label.role: accessible region name — band shown when a site the user blocked asks again

ui.browser.media_access.blocked.role: status text — browser permission band, blocked state
ui.browser.media_access.blocked.note: site = the website's host (e.g. meet.google.com), never translated. The user earlier chose Block for this site; the page's request was just refused. devices select as in prompt_label.

ui.browser.media_access.blocked_hint.role: secondary hint after the blocked text
ui.browser.media_access.blocked_hint.note: 'Allow' refers to the adjacent button: use the same word as ui.browser.media_permission.allow. After allowing, the user retries the page's own camera/microphone button. devices select as in prompt_label: audio/video name ONE device ('it'; pick the pronoun or noun that agrees with microphone or camera in your language), other = both ('them'). Keep every arm.

ui.browser.media_access.system_blocked_l.role: accessible region name — macOS privacy notice band
ui.browser.media_access.system_blocked_l.note: macOS privacy settings turn this app's device access off. devices select as in prompt_label.

ui.browser.media_access.system_blocked_h.note: Points to macOS System Settings › Privacy & Security; use the locale's official macOS names where Apple localizes them. 'Local Operator' is the product name: do not translate. macOS often applies the change only after the app restarts.

ui.browser.media_access.open_system_sett.note: Opens macOS System Settings at the camera or microphone privacy pane. Use Apple's localized name for System Settings.

ui.browser.media_access.notice_dismiss.role: accessible label for an icon-only close button (notice states)
ui.browser.media_access.notice_dismiss.note: Closes the blocked or macOS notice band; changes nothing.
